institution.name: University of Arkansas - Pulaski Technical College

plan.notes: The Associate of General Studies (AGS) is a 60-credit-hour individualized degree designed for maximum course exploration; it is not intended for students who plan to pursue a baccalaureate degree, although some courses may be transferable. The degree must include 14-16 credit hours in a specific area or discipline, developed in cooperation with an advisor, and the approved degree plan must be on file with the graduation coordinator prior to application for graduation. CREDIT-RANGE HANDLING: the graduation map lists several elective slots as ranges (3-4, 2-4, 2-3 credits). Lower bounds are used per collection rule, so the mapped semester sums are Sem 1 = 15, Sem 2 = 15, Sem 3 = 13, Sem 4 = 14 (total 57). The map's semester targets are Sem 1 = 15 hours, Sem 2 = 15-16, Sem 3 = 15, Sem 4 = 14-15; the student works with an advisor to select courses within the stated ranges to reach the required 60 credit hours. Additional prerequisite courses may be required if minimum placement test scores are not met.
